tasks.label: g++ build active file
args: OUT="${workspaceFolder}/output/${relativeFileDirname}/${fileBasenameNoExtension}"; mkdir -p "${workspaceFolder}/output/${relativeFileDirname}"; PIDS=$(lsof -t "$OUT" 2>/dev/null || true); if [ -n "$PIDS" ]; then kill -9 $PIDS; fi; COMPILER=$(command -v g++-15 || command -v g++-14 || command -v g++-13 || command -v /opt/homebrew/bin/g++-15 || command -v /usr/local/bin/g++-15 || command -v g++); "$COMPILER" -std=c++17 -Wall -Wextra -O0 -g3 "${file}" -o "$OUT"
